sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photograph for Veda Group, a premium international business development website. Landscape 3:2 composition. Restrained architectural editorial photography, sophisticated navy, slate, soft teal and warm stone palette, natural light, real material texture, calm assured mood, exceptional photographic realism. No text, logos, watermarks, handshakes, floating graphics or staged smiling stock-photo poses.
